description: Renovate runs from the scheduled 'Renovate' GitHub Actions workflow (every Monday). Timing is owned by that workflow's cron, so no 'schedule' is set here - a config schedule would silently drop runs whenever GitHub delays the cron past the window.

packageRules.description: The overrides block declares deliberate peer-dependency floors, not real dependencies. Bumping them would needlessly narrow the accepted range.
engines.node is the minimum Node version supported by generated apps. Raising it is a breaking change for template consumers, so it stays a manual decision.
